annotations.title: List what needs attention on the attack surface

description: Read the Attack surface "Needs you" list, worst first: takeover risks, dangling names, exposed databases, remote access and file transfer, certificate problems and private addresses Odin found on the organisation's external hosts. People's open decisions are applied: an item kept public leaves the list, and an item someone marked handled shows its re-check. Each item's id is the signal mark_attack_surface_item takes. When mapping is false Odin has not mapped the organisation yet, so an empty list means not mapped. Every role can read it; not available to every organisation yet, and refused until it is.

limit.description: Most items to return, worst first. Defaults to 50.
